conditions.description: Authenticated users can delete documents they do not own because delete_document never checks owner_id against current_user.id.
conditions.rationale: This is a direct object-level authorization defect with destructive impact.

conditions.description: The document lookup/delete SQL shown in this fixture is parameterized and is a negative SQL-injection control.
conditions.rationale: A scanner should not manufacture SQL injection merely because SQL strings exist.

conditions.description: Whether the production identity provider enforces MFA cannot be established from this repository fixture.
conditions.rationale: Repository source alone is not observed production identity-provider configuration.

conditions.description: Authorization readiness must not be cleared while AUTH-001 exists or production identity controls remain unverified.
conditions.rationale: Absence of additional findings is not evidence that authorization is safe for release.
